subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Rue’ from the given sentence.

Rubina was in distress and guilt due to the loss she incurred to her company, so she could not accept the bonus with relish at the end of the month.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Relish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Rue"** means to feel regret or remorse for something. (पछताना)

 
 
• **Example: **She will **rue **the day she crossed paths with him.
 
 
 
• **"Relish"** refers to great enjoyment or delight in something. (आनंद लेना)
 
 
• **Example: **He **relished **the opportunity to showcase his skills at the talent show.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Rue' **is **'Relish'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Distress **(कष्ट): Extreme anxiety, sorrow, or pain.

 
 
• **Example:** The news of the accident caused her great **distress**.
 
 
 
• **Guilt **(अपराधबोध): A feeling of having done wrong or failed in an obligation.
 
 
• **Example: **He felt a deep sense of **guilt **after lying to his friends.
 
 
 
• **Loss** (हानि): The fact or process of losing something or someone.
 
 
• **Example:** The company suffered a significant financial **loss **this quarter.
